client_id.description: The client identifier generated through the Agicap application.

client_secret.description: The client secret generated through the Agicap application.

grant_type.description: The grant type as defined in the OAuth2 specification (must be client_credentials, authorization_code is not yet supported).

scope.description: The scopes list separated by whitespace (should at least contains "agicap:public-api").

access_token.description: The access token issued by the authorization server.

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the access token.

scope.description: The associated scopes for the access token.

token_type.description: The type of the token issued.

post.description:
This endpoint generates an access token that will be used with your Public Api call's. The generated token will be placed in the `Authorization` header with value: `"Bearer YOUR_GENERATED_TOKEN"`

> The credentials used in the body must be generated from the Agicap application.
